description: Land Title Settlement Department - Adukkana Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420351 (23/0612)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, cadastral map references, owner details, extent of land, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
